notes.title: Bring your Taiko fun to life with the Taiko no Tatsujin Drum Controller!
notes.content:
Bring your Taiko fun to life with the Taiko no Tatsujin Drum Controller for the Xbox Series X|S and Windows 11/10. This wired drum controller is specifically designed to enhance your Taiko no Tatsujin: Rhythm Festival gaming experience. Includes two Taiko drumsticks featuring a Taiko no Tatsujin design theme. Based on the popular arcade version, the drum controller is equipped with a pressure-sensitive pad covering the face and rim of the drum that accurately detects the location of each of your taps. Navigate through the menu and select songs with Built with convenient onboard buttons, or simply tap the rim and face of the drum with the included drumsticks to navigate in game. The stand provides a stable playing experience and includes storage space for the Taiko drumsticks. Officially licensed by Microsoft & Bandai Namco Entertainment. (Required Taiko no Tatsujin: Rhythm Festival game software sold separately.) Not compatible with Taiko no Tatsujin: The Drum Master!

Taiko No Tatsujin Drum Controller for Xbox Series X|S and Windows 11/10
- Pressure pad accurately detects location of each tap
- Drum stand provides a stable playing experience and storage space for Taiko Drumsticks
- Includes wired Taiko Drum Controller, drum controller stand, and a set of drum sticks
Officially Licensed by Microsoft & Bandai Namco Entertainment

Designed for Taiko no Tatsujin: Rhythm Festival. A pressure-sensitive drum pad with left and right sections of the rim will get you right into the rhythm!
Includes two Taiko Drumsticks and Drum Stand.

Easily operate menus with built-in buttons and D-pad.

Improved Drum Stand provides a more stable playing experience!
Drum Stand also includes storage space for Taiko Drumsticks.

Compatible with Taiko no Tatsujin: Rhythm Festival*

It’s time to discover the lively Omiko City!

Players will join Don-chan and Kumo-kyun on a musical adventure with everyone’s favourite Taiko elements coming together in various festivals and rhythm battles.
 
In addition to the classic Taiko mode, players can enjoy the ultimate celebration of music with up to 4 players in Taiko Land or face others online in Dondoko Town.

notes.title: Taiko no Tatsujin: Rhythm Festival is coming on Steam! 🥁
notes.content:
Welcome to Omiko City, where everyone’s favorite Taiko elements come together in one place!

Taiko no Tatsujin: Rhythm Festival is coming soon on Thursday, November 7!

[previewyoutube=NzsXvgG9WRY;full][/previewyoutube]
 
What is Taiko no Tatsujin?
Taiko no Tatsujin is a Japanese Drum Rhythm Game where players simulate drumming a traditional Japanese Taiko. Using a drum controller or buttons, players hit the drum's center or rim in time with the on-screen notes.
 
About Taiko no Tatsujin: Rhythm Festival
The most extensive volume in the series, the Standard Edition features 76 new songs, including top hits like “Gurenge”, “Feel Special” and “Racing into the Night”! Along with Concierge mode, which allows you to practice specific parts of a song, and Online Ranked Matches with players worldwide, the new Run! Ninja Dojo mode allows for up to 4 players to compete and overcome a range of obstacles in their path.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170838/964667ea7375ba74cd17767c9c8ebfe28a4d3d0a.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170838/6728b2ee4f1465c600c13e3eb22a2cc9d4d98e96.png

In addition to the Standard Edition, the digital-only Taiko no Tatsujin: Rhythm Festival The Setlist Edition brings a ton of popular hits!
 
120 FPS — a first on home consoles
Enjoy a smoother-than-ever Taiko Mode experience with a framerate of  120 fps — a first on home consoles!
 
New platform-specific collaboration characters and songs!
The Steam version features new songs and characters from popular games too:
•	Monster Hunter: World Medley
•	DR. WILY STAGE 1
•	Last Surprise (from Persona 5)
 
 
Pre-order Bonus
Pre-order the game and get the Namco Game Music Pack featuring 5 tracks from classic Namco titles.
